{{Hatnote|For the era article, see [[Virtual Legacy]]. For the earlier numbered sets, see [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Full constructed pool: [[Legacy Open]].}}
The '''Virtual Blocks (2009-2014)''' are the [[Players Committee]] Virtual Block packages of the [[Virtual Legacy]] era. The [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]] grouped the previous numbered Virtual Sets into six thematic Blocks.<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Blocks 7 through 9 are later expansions. Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] sit in the same pool. The full constructed pool is [[Legacy Open]].
